posts.name: morph147
posts.cooked:
So as you all know, E3 is coming up. So it’s getting close for so many new games to get announced. As always this is me hoping that Handelabra will do an E3 presentation. So if Handelabra does an E3 presentation, what do you want to see?

 

My wish list:

a trailer for Oblivaeon content. I feel like this needs several different ones to represent the different expansions, and we haven’t gotten a good trailer from them in a while.

an announcement of story mode for SoTM.

Bottom of the ninth update, would love some of the mini expansions to hit the table as well as maybe club house. Hopefully to be released around playoff season.

finally an announcement of spirit island the video game, because this needs to happen sooner than later.

 

in previous years sentinel tactics has been up there on my wish list from them but I have a feeling until prime war gets sorted out, this ain’t happening.
